versions.content: Publishing of a SOME/IP Event group A ProvidedServi- ceInstance publishes an event group for each EventHandler that is aggregated in the role eventHandler . The eventGroupIdentifier identifies the SOME/IP Event Group in the context of the ProvidedServiceInstance . With the publishing of an event group the server offers to push notifications about updates to all clients that are subscribed to the event group.
